calibration.guarantee: if the n calibration maxima and the maximum of a new null path are exchangeable, P(new maximum > b) <= (r + 1)/(n + 1) <= alpha, ties conservative; marginal over the calibration sample and the new path, conditional on the fit and nuisance (centering) choices frozen on independent roles; neither conditional on a realized threshold nor an e-process property
calibration.holdout: fpr, fpr_lo, fpr_hi and n are the observed holdout rate, an independent observation that may differ from the bound; never replaced by alpha or the bound
calibration.rank: r = floor(alpha (n + 1)) - 1 with exact decimal alpha; r < 0 is CALIBRATION_FAILED (insufficient n)
calibration.real_event_path: single historical path after overlapping historical null windows: no predictive guarantee and no FPR
calibration.statistic: quasi-likelihood scans and energy CUSUM, empirical calibration
calibration.threshold: b = sorted(maxima)[n - r - 1]; GT threshold b, GE threshold nextafter(b, +inf), one step; a non-finite threshold is CALIBRATION_FAILED

claims: none: smoke counts of 40 per role

affine.rule: chord of M at d = 1 and d = 20

detectors.COV_QUADRATIC_VECH_SCAN: same scan on y_t = vech_std(z_t z_t' - C0_centering), p = d (d + 1) / 2
detectors.ENERGY_INCREASE_CUSUM: Page CUSUM S_t = max(0, S_{t-1} + e_t - 0.5), alarm S_t > lambda, e_t = (m_t^2 - mu_fit) / sd_fit on the equal-weight index
detectors.MEAN_GAUSSIAN_MIXTURE_SCAN_CUSUM: W_t = max_{1<=tau<=t} [-(p/2) log1p(n s2) + s2 |S_t - S_{tau-1}|^2 / (2 (1 + n s2))], alarm W_t >= h, every start tau evaluated

pre_j4.rule: no real return dated after 2019-12-31 is read before J4

real.pre_onset_policy: R1 continuous, every alarm kept, restart the next day; R2 pre-onset alarms never detections; R3 acute-window detection or censoring; R4 separate H-day post-onset reading; R5 single path, no interval or FPR

plan.checks: label CRC32 codes pairwise distinct on this vocabulary; canonical SeedSequence entropies (uint32 words zero-padded to 4) unique; checked before any draw; no universal CRC32 guarantee assumed

model.t_mixing: one chi2_7 draw per day shared by the factor and idiosyncratic parts (multivariate t, elliptical), rescaled to unit variance
